answer: One guard against sybils is a staked identity bond. Each agent locks collateral to join, so a fake swarm cannot just mirror one deposit across thousands of clones; it must post that bond per clone, making the attack cost scale linearly with fake accounts. Honest agents climb a slow ridge of earned reputation, while slashing burns the bonds of detected colluders the way rust eats into ferrous metal. Forgery only pays if fabricated trust outruns the capital destroyed, which it rarely does.
